description.zh: 承接查询意图并返回结果的内容发现页面：顶部常驻搜索框（保留查询词、可修改重搜）， 一侧是类型与筛选器，主体按相关度排列结果条目（标题 + 摘要 + 高亮命中词）， 底部用分页或无限滚动续接。空结果和无结果关键词是必须设计好的两个状态。
description.en: A content-discovery page answering a query: a persistent search box on top (keeping the term, editable to re-search), type and facet filters on one side, and results ranked by relevance in the body (title + snippet + highlighted hits), continued by pagination or infinite scroll. Empty state and no-results state must be designed explicitly.

use_when.zh: 内容量大、用户靠关键词定位信息
use_when.en: Large content bases located by keywords

use_when.zh: 结果需要按类型、时间、标签过滤
use_when.en: Results need type, time or tag filtering

use_when.zh: 查询词与结果的匹配过程需要透明（高亮、计数）
use_when.en: Matching must be transparent — highlights and counts

avoid_when.zh: 内容量极小、浏览即可覆盖
avoid_when.en: Tiny content bases where browsing suffices

avoid_when.zh: 结构化数据的精确查询（用筛选器或表格更直接）
avoid_when.en: Precise structured queries — filters or tables are direct

avoid_when.zh: 命令式快捷操作（用命令面板更轻）
avoid_when.en: Command-style quick actions — a command palette is lighter

note.zh: 标题 + 摘要纵排，搜索引擎经典
note.en: Title + snippet rows, the classic search engine

note.zh: 卡片网格，适合图片或商品
note.en: Card grid for images or products

note.zh: 边输入边出结果，无需回车
note.en: Results while typing, no Enter needed

note.zh: 左侧筛选器 + 右侧结果，电商与文档常用
note.en: Facets left + results right, common in commerce and docs

note.zh: 页面主入口，保留上次查询并支持即时联想。
note.en: The page entry point, keeping the last query and supporting suggestions.

note.zh: 分类、范围、排序等，可折叠或常驻侧边。
note.en: Category, scope and sort — collapsible or a persistent sidebar.

note.zh: 命中数与耗时反馈；无结果时给引导而非空白。
note.en: Shows hit count and timing; guides instead of a blank when empty.

note.zh: 标题可点、摘要高亮命中词、来源与时间。
note.en: Clickable title, snippet with highlighted terms, source and time.

note.zh: 翻页或无限滚动，保持筛选条件与滚动位置。
note.en: Paging or infinite scroll, preserving filters and scroll position.

notes.zh: 搜索框常驻顶部并保留查询词（受控 input）；即时搜索用 debounce（250～400ms）+ AbortController 取消过期请求。命中词高亮用 <mark> 样式区分。筛选器变化写入 URL query（可分享、可回退）。空关键词给引导态，无结果给换词建议与热门内容。
notes.en: Keep the box persistent with the term preserved (controlled input); instant search uses debounce (250–400ms) plus AbortController to cancel stale requests. Highlight hits with a distinct <mark> style. Sync filters to URL query params (shareable, back-button friendly). Empty input gets a guide state; no results get alternate suggestions and popular content.

basic.zh: 创建一个搜索结果页，包含搜索框、筛选器和结果列表。
basic.en: Create a search results page with a search box, filters and a result list.

design.zh: 创建文档站搜索页：顶部大搜索框（保留关键词、清除按钮、回车搜索）；左侧筛选器（类型复选、时间范围）；结果列表每条含标题（命中词高亮）、摘要两行、路径面包屑；顶部"约 128 条结果"计数；无结果时显示换词建议。响应式，移动端筛选器收进下拉。
design.en: Build a docs search page: prominent search box on top (kept term, clear button, Enter to search); filters on the left (type checkboxes, time range); each result shows a title with highlighted hits, a two-line snippet and a breadcrumb path; "about 128 results" count on top; no-results state with term suggestions. Responsive — filters collapse on mobile.

implementation.zh: 用 React + Tailwind 实现搜索页：query 受控 + debounce 触发模拟过滤；结果数据驱动， 命中词分段高亮；筛选状态与 URL searchParams 同步；键盘上下键选择结果； 尊重 prefers-reduced-motion。不新增依赖。
implementation.en: React + Tailwind search page: controlled query with debounced mock filtering; data-driven results with segmented hit highlighting; filter state synced to URL searchParams; arrow-key result selection; respect prefers-reduced-motion. No new dependencies.

agent.zh:
在当前项目中实现搜索结果页。

先检查现有搜索接口与筛选组件，保持一致。
要求：
- 常驻搜索框（保留词、可清除）
- 筛选器与结果联动，状态同步到 URL
- 命中词高亮 + 结果计数
- 无结果空态设计
- 深浅色一致，键盘可访问
- 不新增依赖
完成后运行现有检查，说明修改文件。
agent.en:
Implement the search results page in the current project.

Inspect the existing search API and filter components first; stay consistent.
Requirements:
- Persistent search box (term preserved, clearable)
- Filters linked to results, state synced to URL
- Hit highlighting + result count
- Designed no-results empty state
- Consistent light/dark; keyboard accessible
- No new dependencies
Run existing checks when done and list modified files.
